project.name: LLMEvalOps
project.description: Open-source, enterprise-ready platform for benchmarking, monitoring, and managing LLM & RAG applications with RBAC, structured workflows, and 20+ metrics.

needs.description: Full-time development for 6 months: Add more advanced RAG metrics, multi-modal eval support, better UI dashboards, and production hardening. (Equivalent to ~$30,000 USD)
Bounties for contributors, documentation, tutorials, and community events/meetups in Bengaluru. (Equivalent to ~$10,000 USD)

funding.plans: Short-term: Reach 1.0 release with stable API and more integrations. Long-term: Become the go-to open alternative to proprietary LLM eval tools like LangSmith/DeepEval, support more providers, add auto-debugging features.

acknowledgements: Thanks to RAGAS, LangChain, Spring Boot, FastAPI, and Next.js communities.
